description_en: Queries the bad SQL statements that affect cluster stability within a time range
description_zh: 查看一段时间范围内影响实例稳定的BadSQL
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-bad-sql-detection --db-cluster-id am-xxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2021-05-18T06:00:00Z --end-time 2021-09-30T00:15Z --lang zh --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBadSqlDetection

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查询账号下所有集群的信息详情
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html接口查看指定AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The language. Valid values:

*   **zh (default)**: simplified Chinese.
*   **en**: English.
*   **ja**: Japanese.
*   **zh-tw**: traditional Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
语言配置，取值说明：
- **zh（默认值）**：简体中文。
- **en**：英文。
- **ja**：日文。
- **zh-tw**：繁体中文
parameters.name: lang
